message.content: Good morning. I’m up with Ada and can’t get back to sleep. I need to check the status of the *Henderson* pro bono filing. Did the online portal accept the submission last night, or did it bounce?

content.text: Good morning, Daniel. I checked the logs. The submission was received at 11:42 PM last night. The system returned a confirmation receipt, but there’s a pending flag for missing Form 14-B. Would you like me to draft a quick email to the clerk to clarify, or should I pull the template so you can upload it manually?

message.content: Pull the template. I’ll do it now while Grace is at the office and I have a quiet moment. Also, remind me what Dr. Evans said about Ada’s weight gain at the last check-up? I keep mixing it up with the firm’s Q1 metrics.

content.text: Dr. Evans noted that Ada is tracking well along the 75th percentile and is gaining weight steadily. No concerns raised. I’ve opened the Form 14-B template on your screen. It’s a standard affidavit of service. Do you need me to pre-fill any of the case details from the *Henderson* file?

message.content: Yes, please pre-fill the case number and the defendant’s address. I need to be precise. Also, while you’re at it, send me the draft of my return-to-work plan for the partners. I need to send it by Friday.

content.text: The case details are pre-filled. I’ve also attached the return-to-work draft. It outlines your hybrid schedule starting April 14th, with two days in the office and three remote. I’ve highlighted the section on the *Vanguard* merger file where you propose to hand off the due diligence to junior associates. Does that allocation look right to you?

message.content: It looks fine. Keep the handoff vague for now; I’ll finalize the list when I’m back. For the pro bono form, just double-check the jurisdiction clause. I don’t want to send it back if it’s wrong.

content.text: The jurisdiction clause is set to the Superior Court of Justice for Ontario, which matches the *Henderson* file. I’m attaching the completed Form 14-B for your final review before you submit it through the portal.

message.content: Looks good. I’ll submit it now. Thanks. I need to go change a diaper, but I’ll review the return-to-work plan again after breakfast.

content.text: You’re welcome, Daniel. I’ll keep the *Vanguard* handoff list draft saved for when you’re ready. Let me know if you need anything else before you head back to work.
